  - White pencil-thin streaks that merge into complete leaf scalding/blanching
  - Reddish-pink discoloration of leaf sheaths at the crown (clearly visible in test image)
  - Progressive systemic infection turning leaves pale/straw-colored

The reddish-brown crown discoloration combined with the extensive white/pale bleaching of leaves is a hallmark of **Leaf_Scald**.
